name: upscale
description: Real-ESRGAN x2/x4 image upscaling (SRVGGNetCompact) on Strix Halo with HIP

releases.notes: First release: Real-ESRGAN SRVGGNetCompact (realesr-animevideov3, realesr-general-x4v3, realesr-general-wdn-x4v3) as an image_generation provider for /v1/images/edits, x2 and x4. GPU-validated on Strix Halo (Windows) against Gufo main 0d238d4f; bit-identical to the in-tree upscaler of gufo-studio-windows. Video upscaling is not included yet.
